entities.summary: Mukhammadkodir Toshtemirov is an Uzbekistani weightlifter. He won the bronze medal in the men's 81 kg event at the 2023 World Weightlifting Championships held in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. He also won bronze at the 2024 World Weightlifting Championships held in Bahrain.
